_comment_1: Merge these into ~/.claude/settings.json. Do not paste this file whole over yours - it would wipe everything else. Delete the _comment lines when you're done; JSON has no comments and these are only here to be read.
_comment_2: 1. Top level: set the model you actually run, so the hook can resolve your context-window size and show a percentage. Drop this and you still get a raw token count.
_comment_3: 2. The hook itself. If you already have a hooks block with a UserPromptSubmit array, add ONLY the inner object below to that array. Fix the -File path to wherever you put the script. On macOS/Linux use pwsh instead of powershell.exe.
